value.rationale: A natural infinite dimension family of SPD coordinate-descent problems on a graph made of positively correlated triangles has a complete globally optimal rate and probability formula, an exact nontrivial phase boundary identifying whether radial or paired-leaf spectral modes limit convergence, and nonuniform optimization benefit even where inverse-positive methods cannot apply. This is not a textbook rescaling or an arbitrary finite example; it completely classifies the specified structured model.
